scope: Direct native comparator, fixed before any external implementation is inspected. This is an execution plan, not a measured result or a new solver framework.
estimator_inputs: Profiled finite observation increment, the admitted finite forward callback, native source design/projector and frozen identified basis. Injection vectors/labels and expected outputs are evaluation-only.
baseline: Existing recover_profiled_increment calculation, with its truth-dependent fields treated strictly as scoring. The estimate is computed solely from the profiled observation and SVD.

direct_attempts.name: local defect correction
direct_attempts.method: Iterate the existing native pseudoinverse on the measured residual minus the actual finite forward response. Preserve the frozen identifiable source basis and leave null amplitudes unassigned.
direct_attempts.limit: At most eight iterations; no fitted weights, source prior or injected-vector initialization.

direct_attempts.name: SciPy nonlinear least squares
direct_attempts.method: Use scipy.optimize.least_squares with the actual finite physical residual in the same frozen identifiable basis and the library's three-point finite-difference Jacobian. Start from the existing linear estimate. Preserve physical-domain failures and original weights.
direct_attempts.limit: At most 20 residual iterations; no parameter bound or regularizer inferred from the injected amplitude.

interpretation: Both are direct local alternatives, not Missing Link contributions. Benchmark the best valid result and report runtime and failed/unexecuted cases. If they satisfy the entire need, keep that result and do not force an external contribution.
stop: A practical overall 30-minute native execution limit per method, single numerical thread, with timeouts and unexecuted controls retained explicitly. This is a bounded comparison, not proof that all stronger direct algorithms fail. Partial control completion cannot certify the full acceptance condition.
timing: Complete direct comparison before inspecting selected external source code. No selected-donor implementation, handoff or generated patch may influence its design. Metadata planning/selection alone does not establish source-code value.
execution_status: Not yet executed; the original 30-control linear replay is separately measured in native-preflight.json.
